critical_code_review_comments: server.py /ai/generate injects 'Date of this document: {UTC date} — include a line "Dated: {date}"' into the prompt (line 480) — verified: generated content reliably includes 'Dated:' with date-only (no time). Template param appended as 'Template style: {template} — structure and tone MUST follow this template style' — pass-through only, not validated against an enum; harmless because the LLM copes with any string, but a strict allow-list would be safer.

TemplatePicker.tsx correctly branches NDA vs generic based on category.toLowerCase().includes('nda'); both arrays have 5 entries as claimed. Card testIDs use `template-${name.replace(/ /g, '-')}` — 'Formal Legal', 'One-way NDA' etc are stable.

receive/[id].tsx: locked-gate correctly hides document content (only shows title/sender/category/received-date + lock card) — searched innerText for 'CONFIDENTIAL NDA CONTENT' pre-verify and confirmed NOT present. Sign step embeds sender_signature via SignatureView, printed name, and date-only via new Date(...).toLocaleDateString(). Attached materials list only rendered when doc.attached_files.length > 0.

viewer.tsx: sensible platform split — Web downloads pdf via fetch+blob→base64, native via FileSystem.downloadAsync. Both paths POST /api/pdf/pages then render as horizontal FlatList with pagingEnabled and page-counter '{n} / {total}'. Fallback: iframe on web, Google Docs viewer wrap on Android, direct WebView on iOS. Robust.

server.py /scanner/annotate uses strokes as List[List[List[float]]] (strokes → points → [x,y] normalized 0-1) — matches PageMarkup.tsx normalization; polylines drawn with cv2 at thick = max(2, int(width*w)). /scanner/sign-image parses SVG-like 'M/L' path commands via regex; supports mode='draw'|'type'|'upload' — 'draw' verified.

create/secure.tsx: Draft button is correctly disabled when either intent or template is empty (`disabled={!intent || !template || loading}` line 150) — matches spec: 'Draft button disabled until template picked'.

editor.tsx tools sheet contains rows for Font colour (selection) with 8 hex dots (verified count via [data-testid^='font-color-'] = 8), Shadow AI toggle, Font style, Font size chips (numeric). Font-colour palette applies via document.execCommand('foreColor', …) — standard approach.
